item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs rtsod pa bzlog pa'i khro bo bsgrub pa'i lag len bsdus don nyams su len thabs dwangs shel me long
item.coloph: ces pa'i sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i yang srid sangs rgyas gling pa'i zhabs rdul spyi bor len pa/ thos chung rmongs rgan gsang sngags grags pas rang 'dra'i thos chung myong med kyang / 'phags pa'i mched chung drung mu tshul mi dang / phyag mdzod pa drung mu khi khar gnyis kyis lha yi reg bya dang / rin po che'i yang rtse'i (rtses) spras te nan gyis bskul ba'i bka' mi bzlog phyir/ grogs rang tshul mi'i (mis) bgyis te/ gzi shod dga' ba lung gi dbus/ dga' ldan dpal ri'i 'bangs / bkra shis smin grol khrod ces g.yung drung dpal gyi gdan sar shing stag gi zla tshes bcu gcig gi gza' skar legs pa'i nyin bris pa bkra shis/
